title_en: The Position of Allama al-Haydari on the Theory of Shaykh al-Ahsa'i and Allama al-Tabatabai Regarding the Time of the Appearance of the Expected Imam (may God hasten his reappearance)
summary: A brief clip outlining Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari's stance on the theories proposed by Shaykh al-Ahsa'i and Allama al-Tabatabai concerning the time of the appearance of the Mahdi.
